subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: AC#3 requires that preview context 'can flow through to Contentstack queries in setCommonConfig'. However, none of the public functions (getEntry, getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries, findSingletonEntry) destructure or forward `live_preview` to createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery. They use explicit destructuring without a rest operator, so `live_preview` is silently dropped from every call path. The `live_preview` handling in setCommonConfig (lines 132-136) is dead code — it can never be reached at runtime.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `live_preview` to the destructuring of each public function and forward it in the config object passed to createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery. For example, in getEntry: destructure `live_preview` from the input and include it in the factory.createContentTypeQuery({ ... }) call. Do the same for getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries, and findSingletonEntry.

issues.description: `live_preview.live_preview` accesses a key named 'live_preview' within the Record<string, string>. The live_preview config object (as constructed in `options`) has keys `enable`, `preview_token`, and `preview_hash` — there is no `live_preview` key. This will pass `undefined` to addParam, which is incorrect. The old code correctly used `live_preview.preview_hash` as the value for the live_preview query parameter.
issues.suggestedFix: Use `live_preview.preview_hash` as the value for the `live_preview` query parameter (as the prior code did), or pass the entire live_preview object if the SDK expects that. For example: `(query as any).addParam('live_preview', live_preview.preview_hash);` — or clarify the intended shape of the Record and access the correct key.

issues.description: The typed `IContentstackLivePreviewContext` interface (with `enable?: boolean`, `preview_token?: string`, `preview_hash?: string`) was removed and replaced with `Record<string, string>`. This is a type-safety regression — `enable` was a boolean and is now constrained to string, and the known keys are no longer documented or enforced by the compiler.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore `IContentstackLivePreviewContext` (or an equivalent typed interface) and use it for the `live_preview` field in `ICommonContentstackConfig`. If the query-context shape differs from the Stack-options shape, define a separate interface for each.

issues.description: No tests verify that `live_preview` context actually flows through public functions (getEntry, getSingleEntry, etc.) to setCommonConfig and ultimately to `query.addParam`. The tests only check the `options` object and `setHost` behavior. AC#3 requires that preview context 'can flow through to Contentstack queries in setCommonConfig' — this must be tested.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a test that calls getEntry (or getSingleEntry) with a `live_preview` config and asserts that `addParam` was called on the query with the expected parameters.

issues.description: Missing test for setHost fallback behavior: when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is unset but CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST is set, setHost should be called with CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST. The code has this fallback path (lines 84-86) but it is untested. Learned review rules indicate this test previously existed and was removed, contributing to a test count decrease (22→20).
issues.suggestedFix: Add a test: 'should call setHost with CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is unset' that verifies Stack.setHost is called with the API host value. Also add: 'should not call setHost when neither PREVIEW_HOST nor API_HOST is set'.

issues.description: `contentstack.Stack(options as any)` uses an untyped `any` cast without a per-use explanatory comment. While the file has a blanket `/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */`, the review criteria require explanatory comments for `any` usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an inline comment explaining why the cast is necessary (e.g., Contentstack SDK types don't include live_preview in StackOptions), or extend the SDK's type definition via declaration merging.

issues.description: `(query as any).addParam(...)` uses untyped `any` casts on lines 133 and 135 without explanatory comments. The Contentstack SDK's Query type may not expose `addParam` in its TypeScript definitions.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an inline comment explaining the SDK type gap, or create a typed wrapper/declaration that extends the Query type with `addParam`.
